summary: ZOOZ Strategy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company had previously received a deficiency notice on December 16, 2025, due to its share price closing below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days. On June 15, 2026, Nasdaq confirmed that for the 10 consecutive business days from June 1 to June 12, 2026, the closing bid price was $1.00 or greater, thereby closing the bid price deficiency. This is a routine regulatory compliance update and does not constitute a special situation.
